task.description: One atomic brand-generation task. visual_identity_spec follows creator-brand-visual-spec.v1; brand_strategy_brief follows creator-brand-strategy-brief.v1; brand_kit follows creator-brand-kit.v1; the rest return naming options.

brief.description: Source-bound creator, niche, audience, promise, and style context.

delivery_language.description: BCP-47 tag of the language the Creator-facing strings are written in, such as en, zh-CN or pt-BR. The v1 values English and 中文 remain valid. Fixed labels in the rendered result are English.

requested_count.description: How many options the creator asked for, when they named a number. Only for naming and bio tasks; at most the task default (10 for channel names and usernames, 8 for bios). Omit it to deliver the default.

tone.description: Optional tone direction supplied by the user.

must_include.description: Terms the user explicitly wants considered.

avoid.description: Terms, claims, or styles the user explicitly excludes.
